text:
tess: morning — quick design thread about the vectors preview export and compact density toggles. two asks: 1) what fields we include in the default CSV vs an extended JSONL export, 2) keyboard + screen reader behavior for the compact layout.
omar: re: csv vs jsonl  customers want a tiny CSV for quick review (id, score, rank) and a JSONL with full provenance. CSV should be the default.
rika: we also heard requests for stable filenames: pattern like `rerank-<run_id>-<date>.csv` so users can programmatically pick latest. add model version to filename? maybe optional.
kai: keyboard/accessibility: in compact mode rows are denser. we can't lose 44px hit target on interactive elements. propose: keep non-interactive cells smaller but keep checkbox and kebab at 44px. arrow key navigation should move cell-to-cell; Enter opens row details.
tess: good call. also when user toggles compact mode, announce "Compact view enabled: interactive targets preserved" via polite aria-live.
omar: export payload suggestion: default CSV header: `vector_id, rerank_score, original_rank` (keep it minimal). JSONL line should include run metadata. example JSONL line:
```
{"vector_id": "vec_123", "rerank_score": 0.872, "original_rank": 5, "run_id": "run_2026_03_01", "model_id": "gptx-rerank-v2", "prompt_hash": "sha256:abc...", "timestamp": "2026-03-01T12:34:56Z", "prompt": "..."}
```
(note: prompt included only when user opts into full export)
rika: copy tweak: export menu label should read `Export results` and menu item for full provenance `Export results (include run details)`  avoids jargon. add sr-only helper: `Includes model version, prompt hash, and run id`
kai: a11y nit  when scores update live, we should not re-focus rows. use an aria-live region near the header that says `Scores updated: 3 changed` then let user inspect. avoid per-row live spam.
tess: agree. also add option in settings: `Announce live score updates` default off.
omar: CSV edgecase: customers sometimes need embedding vector contents. recommend we never include full vector array by default (too big); provide `Include embeddings` checkbox in export modal (disabled by default and with warning).
rika: UI: export modal layout: top row = file type toggle (CSV | JSONL), below that checkboxes for `Include run details`, `Include embeddings` (warn), sample size dropdown (All | 100 | 1000 | Custom). primary CTA: `Download` secondary CTA: `Copy export command` (curl)
kai: keyboard flow: tab sequence in modal must follow visual order and trap focus. Escape closes modal. When `Custom` sample selected, focus should move into numeric input and announce `Enter sample size`.
tess: small product question: should `All` be default? big exports might timeout. maybe default to 100.
omar: default 100 sounds safe. add subtle copy: `Default 100 rows to avoid large downloads, change in settings`
rika: test case: screen reader user downloads JSONL with run details; ensure SR announces `Download complete: rerank-run_2026_03_01.jsonl size 230KB` and download link focus.
kai: dev note: backend will provide `run_id`, `model_id`, `prompt_hash`, `timestamp`, `sample_size`, and `export_signature` for integrity checking. expose `export_signature` only in JSONL.
tess: can someone mock the export modal with compact table visible behind? rika can you mock in figma and include keyboard flows?
rika: yes, I'll post frames and a handoff doc with aria attributes.
omar: I'll implement backend flags for `include_embeddings` and `include_prompt` opt-in. will add server-side rate limit for large exports.
tess: thanks all. follow-ups: rika figma + aria, omar backend flags, kai accessibility test plan. closing thread. :sparkles:
